<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentFailure" name="Payment failure notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BackorderDelay" name="Back-order delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingConfirmation" name="Shipping confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Feedback request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Issues" name="Reported delivery issues"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnLabel" name="Return shipping label"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReturnedItems" name="Returned items"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="E-commerce company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Places order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentFailure" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BackorderDelay" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReportIssues" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_IssuesReported" messageRef="Message_Issues"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnLabel" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReturnedItems" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" messageRef="Message_ReturnedItems"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentResult" name="Payment successful?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure" messageRef="Message_PaymentFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockAvailability" name="Items in stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitiateBackorder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform customer of delay" messageRef="Message_BackorderDelay"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveBackorder" name="Receive back-order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Continue with available items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QualityControl" name="Perform quality control checks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare order and shipping documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageOrder" name="Package order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrapRequest" name="Gift wrapping requested?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" name="Continue packaging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalOrder" name="International order?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomsMerge" name="Continue shipping preparation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Packaging and documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DispatchOrder" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation" messageRef="Message_ShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm successful delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send follow-up feedback email" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderFulfilled" name="Order fulfillment complete"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Returns" name="Process returns" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IssuesReported" name="Customer reports delivery issues" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Issues" messageRef="Message_Issues"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label" messageRef="Message_ReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items" messageRef="Message_ReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnResolution" name="Refund or replacement?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process refund"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReplacement" name="Process replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RefundProcessed" name="Refund processed"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReplacementProcessed" name="Replacement processed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IssuesReported" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_2" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_4" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnResolution"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_5" name="Refund" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnResolution" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refund}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_6" name="Replacement" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnResolution" targetRef="Task_ProcessReplacement">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${replacement}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="EndEvent_RefundProcessed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_8" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReplacement" targetRef="EndEvent_ReplacementProcessed"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_3" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Failed" name="Payment failed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentResult" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentFailed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Successful" name="Payment successful" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentResult" targetRef="Task_CheckStock">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailure_1" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_4" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Available" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allRequiredItemsInStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Backorder" name="Out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailability" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackorder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsOutOfStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_1" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackorder" targetRef="Task_InformDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_2" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBackorder" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_6" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_7" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Packaging" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Shipping" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_1" sourceRef="Task_PackageOrder" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_Yes" name="Requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapRequest" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${giftWrappingRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_No" name="Not requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapRequest" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not giftWrappingRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_2" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_2" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipping_1" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_Yes" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalOrder}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International_No" name="Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not internationalOrder}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customs_1" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCustomsDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shipping_2" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DispatchOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_8" sourceRef="Task_DispatchOrder" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_9" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_10" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_11" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_12" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderFulfilled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
